name: GitHub PR
description: Review another person's pull request, iterate on feedback and failing checks on your own, or adopt a contributor's pull request and carry it to merge, changing nothing until you approve the exact action or adoption contract.

deps._runtime_contract: Skills are addressed by registered name; source values are install guidance only.

system.name: gh
system.purpose: Signed-in GitHub CLI for reading the pull request and, after approval, creating reviews, replying, resolving threads, and merging in adopt mode.

system.name: git
system.purpose: Detached checkouts, and committing and pushing approved fixes to the pull request's head branch.

input.arguments: A GitHub pull request number or URL in the repository whose origin remote is on github.com, and the mode: review, iterate, or adopt.

artifacts: Review: a drafted then pending review. Iterate: a per-item plan, then one commit, replies, and resolved threads. Adopt: an evaluation, an approved contract, then pushed fixes and a pinned merge.
